boundary.resolution: GPU drawing/raw local-memory operations are distinguished from prior geometry/lighting/depth ordering and actual PCRTC scanout. Independent complete-reader review closes cross-section ownership and existing adjacent-unit references.

registers.resolution: Both port addresses/access/reset scopes, all 32 GPUSTAT bits, all GP1 controls/query aliases, all 256 GP0 classifications and every polygon/line/polyline/rectangle/fill/upload/readback/copy/E1–E6 word/field/option/reset/state effect are integrated. Independent paragraph audits and complete-reader review cover the operation reference.

datapath.resolution: Storage/placement, coverage/shared edges, finite planes/line recurrence, packed/direct textures and CLUTs, window/flip/gain/dither/blend/mask, raw fill/transfers and overlapping traversal have sourced numerical lessons reconnected to complete packet references and actual cartridge operands.

visibility.resolution: Admission/assembly/parser execution, retained per-command/per-segment snapshots, persistent T1 state, command deadlines, reset/clear/readback phases, DMA staging/BLOCK_END and actual PCRTC VBlank publication remain distinct; source, bounded owner replay and whole-reader checks agree.

timing.resolution: Installed resources/access costs and all command-cost equations pass independent arithmetic plus actual TS/C++ timing replay; the complete specified 29-word/63-instruction issue/poll/ack/readout/return function executes in 83 cycles through ordinary and observed CPU dispatch. Physical guarantees are not fabricated. Its 47/44-cycle admitted image-transport charges are independently source-checked and replayed, with deliberately varied readback-service timing explicitly excluded from a fixed READY or whole-program guarantee.

interrupts.resolution: Marker ordering, already-set suppression/re-arming, separate GPU/controller pending acknowledgements, no idle-generated IRQ and request-versus-idle-versus-display publication are covered with actual cartridge and complete scalar timeline evidence.

faults.resolution: Complete CPU port width/alignment/ordered-side-effect and admission/read-ownership policy is sourced. Ignored opcodes, incomplete/count-framed streams and representable fields retain deterministic results, not invented packet faults/recovery. DMA-controller registers and CPU exception-handler programming are not claimed as GPU interfaces.

reset.resolution: Full-device patterned VRAM initialization, GP1/CSR stream-reset effects and BIOS-used cartridge-entry storage remain distinct. Register defaults/preservations, conditional accepted work/partial upload and phase-dependent readback aborts are covered without all-zero-clear, universal queue-completion or rollback promises; the finite firmware reservation is linked.

programming.resolution: Compact packet, texture, transfer and synchronization sequences accompany complete command references, numerical raster examples and actual output plates.
